in_marathi.name: Kamta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Kamta means 'desire' or 'love'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kama', which represents pleasure, desire, or love. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva is the god of desire and love, and the name Kamta is associated with the divine energy of love and passion.
